endpoints.name: Capabilities
endpoints.description: Return of capabilities and description, requests and response of sheets-service.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Read a range from a Google Sheet.
endpoints.notes: If range is empty, usecase defaults to A1:Z1000.

endpoints.name: CreateTable
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST $SERVICE_URL/api/v1/sheets/create  -H Content-Type: application/json  -d '{properties:{title:New Spreadsheet}}' | jq .

endpoints.name: BatchUpdate
endpoints.description: Updates the cell or range of the table to the specified values.

endpoints.name: ClearTable
endpoints.description: Clear values in the specified range (defaults to entire table).

endpoints.name: Share
endpoints.description: Grant reader access to a specific user by email.
endpoints.curl: curl -X POST $SERVICE_URL/api/v1/sheets/share   -H Content-Type: application/json   -d '{email:example@example.com, sendEmail:true, emailMessage:You have read access to the sheet.}' | jq .
